bug_info.bug_desc: In the pre-merge code, prim_fifo_async's read-data output was not explicitly qualified with rvalid_o. The old output mux either passed rdata_int unconditionally when OutputZeroIfEmpty=0, or zeroed only based on empty_rclk when OutputZeroIfEmpty=1. Meanwhile, tlul_fifo_async instantiated both the request and response FIFOs without enabling any zeroing of invalid read-data. As a result, the TL-UL output payload fields driven from rdata_o could hold stale FIFO contents while the corresponding output valid signal was deasserted. This violates the TL-UL async FIFO requirement that all output payload bits be zero when output-valid is low, and can create CDC concerns because invalid payload data may propagate without being qualified by the valid signal.
bug_info.fix_hint: Add an OutputZeroIfInvalid parameter to prim_fifo_async and use it in the read-data output generate branches to drive rdata_o to zero whenever rvalid_o is low. In tlul_fifo_async, set OutputZeroIfInvalid(1) on both the request FIFO and response FIFO instances so that their payload outputs are forced to zero when their respective valid outputs are deasserted.
